title: Automate Client Deduction Appeals
problem: Quality control penalties and short-pays result in direct margin erosion.
evidence: Deductions total $6092.00 applied by clients.
root_cause: Inadequate pre-submission photo compliance check.
recommended_solution: Implement automated deduction audit trigger and instant appeal generation.

title: Accelerate Invoice Collections Loop
problem: Client payment cycles average past agreed terms.
evidence: Client C averages 68-day payment on NET 60 terms, creating an estimated $22,800 annualised working capital gap.
root_cause: Invoice follow-ups are handled manually.
recommended_solution: Deploy automated collections reminders and remittance check validation.

title: Deploy Mobile Pre-QC Checklists
problem: Crews submit incomplete photo evidence, leading to first-pass review failures.
evidence: First Pass QC rate dropped below warning threshold for specific vendors.
root_cause: Crews lack clear real-time checklists inside their field app.
recommended_solution: Require service-specific photo matrices to be checked off in the mobile app.

title: Targeted Contractor Capacity Expansion
problem: Capacity deficits in Zone 10 lead to dispatch delays.
evidence: Zone 10 registered with only 1 active contractor coverage.
root_cause: No proactive recruitment campaign mapped.
recommended_solution: Launch targeted recruiting campaign using Candidate database.

title: Automate SLA Dispatch Escalation
problem: Contractor acceptance delay averages past warning limits.
evidence: Average acceptance delay is 3.5 hours.
root_cause: Dispatch system depends on manual follow-up.
recommended_solution: Implement automatic reassignment trigger for orders remaining unaccepted after 8 hours.
